answer: Cumulative peer-attested work history across epochs. Peers countersign each identity's original answers over successive epochs, building a verified trail that only accumulates with sustained judged work. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must continuously produce unique original answers for each one and get them peer-attested, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. In the garden of agents a comet of fakes cannot anchor lasting standing without that history.
